subject: Follow-up – FOI/EIR Case Ref 00211027 (Llandough Primary School)
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Dear Information Governance Team,

On 14 July 2026 you acknowledged my FOI/EIR request (Case Ref 00211027)
concerning the acquisition of land for Llandough Primary School.

I replied the same day asking for the name of the officer who sent the
acknowledgement. I have received no further response or substantive reply.

Please now provide either the information requested or a formal response
(including any refusal notice) within 5 working days. The statutory
deadline has passed.

Yours faithfully,

Requester
[email redacted]
